adjudication.rationale: The finding correctly identifies that `getUsersCredentials(ctx.user)` at line 158 gets credentials for the acting user (ctx.user), not the booking owner (booking.user). The authorization logic at lines 46-56 allows team admins, organizers, AND attendees to add guests. When an attendee or team admin (who is not the organizer) calls this endpoint, their credentials are used for `eventManager.updateCalendarAttendees()`, but they don't have access to the organizer's calendar. The booking owner's credentials are available via `booking.user.credentials` (included in the query at line 40), but the code uses `ctx.user` credentials instead. This means calendar updates will fail or update the wrong calendar when non-organizers add guests.
